description: With cas.first_data_timeout_ms unset, the Called node's first-data wait stays three answer waits when the slowest ladder rung delivers the largest DATA C_PDU in fewer transmissions.
note: Flow as cas-make-called-first-data-timeout up to the link being made, with cas.first_data_timeout_ms unset and a drc.table, and the run ends once the link's timers have started. At 2000, from 0.0.1.3 (EOT 10), a type 8 D_PDU carrying a PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST with the Ed4 bit set, which records 0.0.1.3 Ed4 (B-0408); the CAS answers PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED, sent at 52000 after the contention wait of 45000 (seed 0, slot 15), at drc.default_speed WN 2 Long since 0.0.1.3 has sent no recommendation. The table's thresholds list is empty, so the burst at 1000 to 3000 gives no estimate and 0.0.1.3, heard and recorded Ed4, is owed MAX-SEGMENT alone, 0xAFF (value 255 to a sender that has sent no SENDER-APPROACH; interp C-1271, C-1272), and no top priority. With a calibrated table this node sends its SENDER-APPROACH, 0xB04, first in a transmission that carries data to the peer, here the type 8 D_PDU (interp C-1286), so the accept carries 0xB04 in place of the template's CAPABILITY 0xF01; that D_PDU differs only in its EOW and header CRC. The link is made at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400) and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 starts (B-0215, B-0216), then the SIS soft link timers, unset and so derived from the answer wait: minimum hold and idle three answer waits, maximum six (A-0321). The derived first-data wait (interp B-0420, revised corpus 0.33.0; corpus-format.md section 6): n answer waits, n the larger of 3 and ceil(2054 / c), where 2054 bytes is the largest DATA C_PDU (1-octet C_PCI, B-0111; 5-octet S_PCI with a TTD, A-0160; a 2048-byte U_PDU at the MTU, A-0047) and c the bytes one transmission of the configured length carries on the ladder's slowest rung, ladder[0]: b = floor((min(127500, dts.max_transmission_ms) - preamble_ms - flush_ms) / block_ms) blocks, at least 1, so c = b x block_bytes - modem.eom_bytes (C-0551, C-1042, C-1290). The answer wait is the derived dts.ack_wait (C-1120): min(127500, dts.max_transmission_ms) + max(lbt_wait_dcd_ms, lbt_wait_vdcd_ms) + num_cont_slots x cont_slot_width_ms. Here dts.max_transmission_ms is the default 127500 and the ladder is WN 4 Long then WN 6 Long, with a fixture entry for WN 4 Long of 256 bytes and 4800 ms a block. The answer wait is 127500 + 30000 + 16 x 3000 = 205500. On WN 4 Long b = floor((127500 - 600 - 150) / 4800) = 26, c = 26 x 256 = 6656, and ceil(2054 / 6656) = 1, so n = 3 and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 starts with 3 x 205500 = 616500, as with an empty table. The soft link minimum hold and idle start with 616500 and the maximum with 1233000, as in the template. drc.default_speed, WN 2 Long, is not on this ladder, so the accept goes at the lowest ladder rung, WN 4 Long (interp C-1280: no ladder rung has a data rate not above 600 bit/s; the link is made at that rung, interp C-1281), still one block, 5550 ms and EOT 10 (C-0104, C-1043). Its 256-byte block takes the 25-byte accept and is filled with 21 PADDING D_PDUs of 11 bytes to the peer recorded Ed4, EOT 10, each carrying the next entry of the repeating set, MAX-SEGMENT 0xAFF (C-1154, interp C-1260).
